explication: Akka is a distributed-systems platform built around the actor model. Users define actor behavior and start an actor system; actors exchange messages, while runtime services provide dispatch, scheduling, supervision, and lifecycle management. The repository also contains classic and typed APIs, reliable delivery, clustering, persistence/query support, streams, and remote transport. The graph preserves these major product branches, but the supplied excerpts are selective, so many subsystem links are documented at a high level rather than traced through implementation calls.
